summary: ZITADEL startup program added to Sourcey as one entity and one offer, PR #1276.

observations.detail: PR #1276 adds exactly one file, entities/zi/zitadel.yaml, holding one new entity and one offer. The shard directory and file name both derive from the slug 'zitadel'. sha256 of the file as committed: f2f8788d4ad3782667a168c872a8aa2ae7b2f30cfb17e0ce426f0beb4d448a41.

The only source cited is https://zitadel.com/startup, a page on the vendor's own domain. Offer: Financial credits toward ZITADEL Cloud, all Cloud features and direct engineering sessions for the first 12 months. Eligibility: Less than $2M funding, no more than 2 years old, backed by an investor or accelerator.
Both required checks are green on the pull request head: 'sourcey/validation' success and 'validate catalog change' success. The commit carries a DCO Signed-off-by line matching the commit author.

The pinned Catalog Verifier was run locally before pushing: 'sourcey-catalog-verify validate startup-credits' reports 'Sourcey verification passed (entities: 1, programs: 0, offers: 1)' against the repository root set and the live parent release.
